title: Variance of a Rademacher summand
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb R$, and choose a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. On the uniformly distributed sign cube, the variance of the function $x\mapsto a_i x_i$ is $a_i^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real number to each coordinate
